GHA.note: Bank of Ghana publishes payment statistics only; no mandate, licensing, switch or regional link stated.
Nothing on government payments to people.
Account counts, registered and active, not a survey share of adults.

facts.fact: The Bank of Ghana reports mobile money in August 2026 at 1,046 million transactions worth GHC 518.8 billion, with 85.8 million registered and 26.4 million active accounts.
The Bank of Ghana reports mobile money interoperability in August 2026 at 35.7 million transactions worth GHC 6.5 billion.

GHA.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
